# 1. Setup

```{python}
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

from py.config import cfg
from py.utils_dates import quarter_diff
```

# 2. Data Import

```{python}
clean_parts = sorted((cfg.derived_dir / "holdext_clean_parquet").glob("*.parquet"))
holdext_clean = pd.concat([pd.read_parquet(p) for p in clean_parts], ignore_index=True)
holdext_clean["rquarter"] = pd.to_datetime(holdext_clean["rquarter"], errors="coerce")
```

# 3. Functions

```{python}
def calculate_fund_returns(holdings_data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = (
        holdings_data.groupby(["cik", "rquarter"], dropna=False)
        .agg(total_value=("value", "sum"), n_holdings=("value", "size"))
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["cik", "rquarter"])
    )
    out["prev_value"] = out.groupby("cik")["total_value"].shift(1)
    out["quarterly_return"] = (out["total_value"] - out["prev_value"]) / out["prev_value"]
    return out


def score_funds_by_horizon(returns_data: pd.DataFrame, horizon_quarters: int, latest_qtr: pd.Timestamp) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = returns_data.loc[returns_data["quarterly_return"].notna()].copy()
    out["quarters_ago"] = out["rquarter"].apply(lambda d: quarter_diff(d, latest_qtr))
    out = out.loc[out["quarters_ago"] <= horizon_quarters].copy()

    rows = []
    for cik, g in out.groupby("cik"):
        if len(g) == horizon_quarters:
            mean_r = g["quarterly_return"].mean()
            sd_r = g["quarterly_return"].std()
            sharpe = np.nan if (pd.isna(sd_r) or sd_r == 0) else mean_r / sd_r
            rows.append(
                {
                    "cik": cik,
                    "n_period": len(g),
                    "mean_return": mean_r,
                    "sd_return": sd_r,
                    "sharpe_ratio": sharpe,
                }
            )

    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def assign_size_buckets(returns_data: pd.DataFrame, latest_qtr: pd.Timestamp, n_buckets: int = 4) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = returns_data.loc[returns_data["rquarter"] == latest_qtr, ["cik", "total_value"]].drop_duplicates().copy()
    out["size_bucket"] = pd.qcut(out["total_value"], q=n_buckets, labels=[f"Q{i}" for i in range(1, n_buckets + 1)])
    return out[["cik", "total_value", "size_bucket"]]


def select_cohort_funds(scored_funds: pd.DataFrame, n_select: int = 10) -> pd.DataFrame:
    sf = scored_funds.sort_values(["sharpe_ratio", "cik"]).reset_index(drop=True)

    top_tbl = sf.sort_values(["sharpe_ratio", "cik"], ascending=[False, True]).head(n_select).assign(cohort="top")
    bottom_tbl = sf.head(n_select).assign(cohort="bottom")

    mid_start = int(np.floor((len(sf) - n_select) / 2))
    middle_tbl = sf.iloc[mid_start : mid_start + n_select].assign(cohort="middle")

    return pd.concat([top_tbl, bottom_tbl, middle_tbl], ignore_index=True)


def get_holdings_at_period_start(holdings_data: pd.DataFrame, selected_funds_tbl: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    sel = selected_funds_tbl[["horizon_years", "start_date", "size_bucket", "cohort", "cik"]].copy()
    return holdings_data[["cik", "rquarter", "cusip", "value"]].merge(
        sel,
        how="inner",
        left_on=["cik", "rquarter"],
        right_on=["cik", "start_date"],
    )


def compute_portfolio_weights(holdings_data: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = holdings_data.copy()
    out["total_value"] = out.groupby(["horizon_years", "size_bucket", "cohort", "cik"]) ["value"].transform("sum")
    out["value_weight"] = out["value"] / out["total_value"]

    out = (
        out.groupby(["horizon_years", "size_bucket", "cohort", "cik", "cusip"], dropna=False)["value_weight"]
        .sum()
        .reset_index()
    )
    return out


def portfolio_vectors_to_matrices(portfolio_vectors: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for keys, g in portfolio_vectors.groupby(["horizon_years", "size_bucket", "cohort"]):
        wide = g.pivot_table(index="cik", columns="cusip", values="value_weight", fill_value=0)
        rows.append(
            {
                "horizon_years": keys[0],
                "size_bucket": keys[1],
                "cohort": keys[2],
                "sim_matrix": wide,
            }
        )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def cosine_similarity_from_matrix(M: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    mat = M.values
    row_norms = np.sqrt((mat * mat).sum(axis=1))
    row_norms[row_norms == 0] = np.nan
    mat_norm = mat / row_norms[:, None]
    sim = np.nan_to_num(mat_norm @ mat_norm.T)
    return pd.DataFrame(sim, index=M.index, columns=M.index)


def extract_unique_pairs(sim_matrix: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    funds = sim_matrix.index.tolist()
    rows = []
    for i in range(len(funds)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(funds)):
            f1 = funds[i]
            f2 = funds[j]
            rows.append(
                {
                    "fund_1": f1,
                    "fund_2": f2,
                    "cos_sim": sim_matrix.loc[f1, f2],
                    "pair_key": f"{min(f1, f2)}_{max(f1, f2)}",
                }
            )
    return pd.DataFrame(rows)


def get_extreme_pairs_by_cohort(cosine_sims: pd.DataFrame, time_horizons: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    rows = []
    for _, r in cosine_sims.iterrows():
        pairs = extract_unique_pairs(r["sim_matrix"])
        if len(pairs) == 0:
            continue

        most = pairs.sort_values("cos_sim", ascending=False).head(1).assign(type="most")
        least = pairs.sort_values("cos_sim", ascending=True).head(1).assign(type="least")
        pair_tbl = pd.concat([most, least], ignore_index=True)

        pair_tbl["horizon"] = r["horizon_years"]
        pair_tbl["size_bucket"] = r["size_bucket"]
        pair_tbl["cohort"] = r["cohort"]

        rows.append(pair_tbl)

    out = pd.concat(rows, ignore_index=True) if len(rows) else pd.DataFrame()
    out = out.merge(
        time_horizons[["horizon_years", "start_date"]],
        left_on="horizon",
        right_on="horizon_years",
        how="left",
    )
    return out


def get_pair_holdings_over_time(holdings_data: pd.DataFrame, pairs_table: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    long_pairs = pairs_table.melt(
        id_vars=["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key", "start_date"],
        value_vars=["fund_1", "fund_2"],
        var_name="fund_slot",
        value_name="fund",
    )

    out = long_pairs.merge(
        holdings_data[["cik", "rquarter", "cusip", "value", "shares"]],
        left_on="fund",
        right_on="cik",
        how="left",
    )
    out = out.loc[out["rquarter"] >= out["start_date"]].copy()
    return out


def calculate_backtest_returns(backtest_holdings: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = (
        backtest_holdings.groupby(["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key", "rquarter"], dropna=False)
        .agg(total_value_pair=("value", "sum"), n_holdings_pair=("value", "size"))
        .reset_index()
        .sort_values(["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key", "rquarter"])
    )

    out["prev_value_pair"] = out.groupby(["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key"]) ["total_value_pair"].shift(1)
    out["quarterly_return"] = (out["total_value_pair"] - out["prev_value_pair"]) / out["prev_value_pair"]
    return out


def compute_backtest_statistics(backtest_returns: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    out = backtest_returns.loc[backtest_returns["quarterly_return"].notna()].copy()

    out = (
        out.groupby(["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key"], dropna=False)["quarterly_return"]
        .agg(n_period="size", mean_return="mean", sd_return="std")
        .reset_index()
    )
    out["sharpe_ratio"] = out["mean_return"] / out["sd_return"]
    out.loc[out["sd_return"] == 0, "sharpe_ratio"] = np.nan

    return out.sort_values(["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "sharpe_ratio"], ascending=[True, True, True, True, False])
```

# 4. Orchestration

```{python}
returns_by_fund = calculate_fund_returns(holdext_clean)

latest_rquarter = returns_by_fund["rquarter"].max()
n_select = 10
n_buckets = 4

time_horizons = pd.DataFrame({"horizon_years": [2, 3, 4, 5]})
time_horizons["quarters_back"] = time_horizons["horizon_years"] * 4
time_horizons["start_date"] = time_horizons["quarters_back"].apply(lambda q: latest_rquarter - pd.DateOffset(months=q * 3))

fund_sizes = assign_size_buckets(returns_by_fund, latest_rquarter, n_buckets=n_buckets)

cohorts = []
for _, hr in time_horizons.iterrows():
    scored = score_funds_by_horizon(returns_by_fund, int(hr["quarters_back"]), latest_rquarter)
    scored = scored.merge(fund_sizes, on="cik", how="inner")

    for sb, g in scored.groupby("size_bucket"):
        selected = select_cohort_funds(g, n_select=n_select)
        selected["horizon_years"] = hr["horizon_years"]
        selected["start_date"] = hr["start_date"]
        cohorts.append(selected)

fund_cohorts = pd.concat(cohorts, ignore_index=True)

holdings_at_start = get_holdings_at_period_start(holdext_clean, fund_cohorts)
portfolio_vectors = compute_portfolio_weights(holdings_at_start)
portfolio_matrices = portfolio_vectors_to_matrices(portfolio_vectors)

cosine_sims = portfolio_matrices.copy()
cosine_sims["sim_matrix"] = cosine_sims["sim_matrix"].apply(cosine_similarity_from_matrix)

extreme_pairs = get_extreme_pairs_by_cohort(cosine_sims, time_horizons)

backtest_holdings = get_pair_holdings_over_time(holdext_clean, extreme_pairs)
backtest_returns = calculate_backtest_returns(backtest_holdings)
backtest_stats = compute_backtest_statistics(backtest_returns)
```

# 5. Results & Interpretation

```{python}
sharpe_wide = backtest_stats[["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort", "type", "pair_key", "sharpe_ratio"]].pivot_table(
    index=["horizon", "size_bucket", "cohort"],
    columns="type",
    values=["sharpe_ratio", "pair_key"],
    aggfunc="first",
).reset_index()

sharpe_wide.columns = ["_".join([str(c) for c in col if c != ""]).strip("_") for col in sharpe_wide.columns.values]
sharpe_wide["sharpe_diff"] = sharpe_wide["sharpe_ratio_most"] - sharpe_wide["sharpe_ratio_least"]

plt.figure(figsize=(7, 4))
plt.axhline(0, linestyle="--", color="grey")
vals = [g["sharpe_diff"].dropna().values for _, g in sharpe_wide.groupby("horizon")]
labels = [str(int(h)) for h in sorted(sharpe_wide["horizon"].dropna().unique())]
plt.boxplot(vals, labels=labels)
plt.xlabel("Horizon (years)")
plt.ylabel("Sharpe(most) - Sharpe(least)")
plt.title("Difference in Sharpe between most- and least-similar pairs")
plt.tight_layout()

overall = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "n_cells": [len(sharpe_wide)],
        "n_most_better": [(sharpe_wide["sharpe_diff"] > 0).sum()],
        "n_least_better": [(sharpe_wide["sharpe_diff"] < 0).sum()],
        "mean_diff": [sharpe_wide["sharpe_diff"].mean()],
        "median_diff": [sharpe_wide["sharpe_diff"].median()],
    }
)
overall

by_horizon = (
    sharpe_wide.groupby("horizon", dropna=False)
    .agg(
        n_cells=("sharpe_diff", "size"),
        n_most_better=("sharpe_diff", lambda x: (x > 0).sum()),
        mean_diff=("sharpe_diff", "mean"),
    )
    .reset_index()
)
by_horizon
```

Controlling for fund size and ex-ante performance cohort, there is no strong, consistent relationship between portfolio similarity and subsequent pair-level Sharpe ratios.
